The '''JY-83''' was a model of [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] produced by [[Lhosan Industries]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Lhosan JY-83 was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with patch 4.7.3. and is available from the Oppressor Alliance Pack.
